HoldingCurrency.name: Holding Currency
HoldingCurrency.definition: Currency of the asset in the holding.

TransferCurrency.name: Transfer Currency
TransferCurrency.definition: Currency of the asset in another currency.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information about the cash asset.

HoldingTransferCurrencyGuideline.definition: When cash is transferred in a currency other than that of the cash, the currency should be specified in TransferCurrency.
